name: Procedural Fire Sampling
definition: Samples a procedural fire texture based on a normalized 3D location and a scale vector, applying time-based vertical scrolling, turbulence-driven vertical offset, and boundary fading to produce a volumetric fire appearance in the fragment shader.
summary: Procedural Fire Sampling generates animated fire by mapping 3D locations to a 2D texture with noise-driven offsets, avoiding pre-computed 3D volumes.
